checks.table_clipping: No clipped or overflowing table observed. Long tables repeat headers on continuation pages.
checks.orphan_headers: No table-header-only page or stranded section heading observed.
checks.new_counterexamples: Page31 visibly prints the three artificial examples. Greek tau, inequality signs and subscripts are readable; distinctions match the earlier mathematical audit.
checks.updated_routes: Page4 S8 caption points to Supplement S11; page5 S9/S10 captions point to S12/S13.
checks.source_version: Page32 explicitly identifies all Ehm page locators as arXiv author-v2 pagination.
checks.references_and_last_page: Added positioning references are visible on pages32–33. Last-page references and all five figure captions end completely within margins.
checks.blank_space: Page2 ends after one complete FX table, leaving lower-page whitespace; final page ends after captions. No empty or apparently missing-content page found.
checks.page_geometry_supplemental_check: pdfplumber found no words beyond page bounds and no replacement/square characters in all33 pages.

nonblocking_observations: Several complete-output tables use compact typography; they remain readable at full-page render scale.
Continuation text across pages3–4 and31–32 is normal paragraph flow, not a missing table continuation.
limitations: This verifies the ReportLab preview. Successful TeX compilation does not make this PDF a TeX export, and compiled-TeX visual layout has not been independently reviewed here.
Contact-sheet inspection was used for every baseline page, with enlarged single-page inspection for dense tables, formula pages and all final changed pages.
verdict: PASS for visual completeness and layout within the stated preview scope
